fields.value: Show live progress and partial results for running eval passes

Problem: while an `etude eval` pass runs on a rented machine, nothing reports how far it has got or what it has scored so far. Observed on manabot MTG-252 (eval run value-readout-252-v1-2daf29f915a4, 1,800 matches on cpu32, 2026-11-07): `etude status` shows only "running, \~$0.31, last loop: 9 seconds ago"; `etude logs --run <id>` shows "job ... output not received; collected=None" and "snapshot incomplete" until the job ends. The previous pass (value-readout-252-v1-0b4f3fc61213) ended "out_of_time" even though its log showed 2250/2250 played and "phase run: exit 0", which was only discoverable after the fact.

Outcome: an operator can see a running eval's progress and read its completed results before the pass ends.

* `etude status <eval run>` reports matches played / total (and failed), with recent pace and an ETA.
* Sealed blocks are uploaded to the bucket as they complete, so `etude report`/observe and evaluation_tables can read partial results mid-pass (marked partial), and a killed or timed-out pass keeps what it played.
* `etude logs --run` (and --follow) surfaces the job's recent stdout while running, not only after collection.
* A pass that played everything and exited 0 is not recorded as out_of_time / failed.

Related bug seen in the same session: the per-computer ledger \~/.etude/experiments/launched.json is shared across experiments, and one failed pass from another experiment (elemental-lambda-v1-6860cc47ef30) makes every later `etude eval` fail with `launched_pass_failed`. Workaround used: back up the ledger, set it to \[\], launch, merge entries back. Fix here or file separately.
